lines.text: Many learners say: I have a question to you.
Better: I have a question for you.
For! She has a question for you.

data.wrong: I have a question to you.
data.right: I have a question for you.

native.tip: По-русски «вопрос к вам», отсюда “to.” В английском: “a question for you.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I have a question to you”? 😅 По-русски «вопрос к вам» тянет за собой “to”, а нужно “for you.” Правильно: “I have a question for you.” Послушай Ама и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “for.” После question — for you. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.caption: Do you also say “I have a question to you”? 😅 The small word feels right, but you need “for you.” Correct: “I have a question for you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
